name: Army Commander Tycoon
desc:
⚔️ Build your base. Command your army. Conquer the battlefield.

Grow from a small military outpost into a powerful war machine. Unlock infantry, tanks, artillery, helicopters and more, then send your army out to capture objectives and crush enemy forces. 💥

🏗️ Build and upgrade your military base
🪖 Recruit powerful troop types
🚙 Unlock tanks, vehicles and aircraft
🎯 Capture strategic points across the map
💰 Earn more income as your army expands
⚔️ Command your forces into huge battles
🔥 Upgrade, conquer and become the strongest commander

Can you build the ultimate army?
